_comment: C0-14 hailuo-video bodies EN. 无附加小节。正文「相关条目」2 行带 .md 链接（kling/jimeng），related 写 2 条（frontmatter related 有 3 项含 veo，键按正文链接行对齐=2）。sources 4 条对齐 frontmatter。filing_no Shanghai-MiniMax-202505230046 属登记号原样保留。

axes.model_access: MiniMax's in-house video model line (Hailuo is its consumer-grade video entry, official narrative); users do not pick bare models. Open-weights line: MiniMax's language models have an open-weights precedent, no official open statement seen for the video line.
axes.runtime: Web (hailuoai.video) + app (as seen in site navigation); generation on the vendor's cloud.
axes.local_files: Works stored account-side in the cloud, generation history visible on the web works page; downloads go local. No officially stated local data surface.
axes.background: Generation is instant/queued (varies by tier, not verified item by item); no "keep-running-after-shutdown" task surface (no claim verified).
axes.tools: Text-to-video and image-to-video are the main functions (official narrative); camera-motion control capability lines (as seen in site copy, details not verified item by item).
axes.context: Organized via the account works page (generation history reviewable); cross-session memory — no official statement verified. Video generation is one-shot tasks; there is no "continue where you left off" concept.
axes.permissions: Account + subscription system (D9: prices not collected); the training-use switch not verified line by line. Filing: the MiniMax model filing no. Shanghai-MiniMax-202505230046 (cross-verified on Alibaba Cloud Model Studio and Baidu Intelligent Cloud official disclosure pages, 2026-10-22) — this is a model-layer filing no.; the Hailuo Video product entry's own filing status was not separately verified.
axes.fit: Fits: domestically available direct-connection text/image-to-video, starting free to test, short-video material output. Does not fit: model self-selection, open weights, enterprise-grade management surfaces.

runs:
This site has not completed measured runs. The coding-oriented test protocol is at [protocols/coding/_protocol.md](../../../protocols/coding/_protocol.md) (the coding task suite does not apply to creative products).

**Suggested measurements** (three, all pointing at things the official readable pages do not give):

- **Generation duration/resolution differences between free and paid tiers** (D9: prices not collected; quota behavior to be measured)
- **The actual controllability of camera-motion control capabilities**
- **Whether works/accounts interoperate between the overseas entry and the domestic entry**
unknowns:
- Open weights for the video line (no official statement verified)
- The training-use switch (not verified line by line)
- The product entry's own generative-AI service filing status (not separately verified)
- Cross-session memory mechanism (no official statement verified)
related: Both domestic video heavyweights: Kling's ecosystem surface (app/plugins) is wider, Hailuo's entry is lighter.
Both domestic image+video one-stop entries: Jimeng embeds in the CapCut ecosystem, Hailuo is a standalone video site.
